name: Hunan Zhongke Electric Co., Ltd.
summary: Hunan Zhongke Electric Co., Ltd. engages in the research and development, production, and sales of electromagnetic metallurgy products in China and internationally. The company offers electromagnetic stirrers, tundish induction heating system, lifting electromagnet, cable drum, magnetic separator, and induction heating system. The company's products are primarily used in steel, non-ferrous metallurgy, rail transportation, scientific research institutions, mines, ports and docks, and marine military industry.
